summary: Frontend-only retest of /games/cards focused on the 3 bug fixes (scroll inside entry modal, slot positions, freeze on final round) and 2 enhancements (round-complete banner + animations). 14/14 assertions PASSED. Bugs are fully resolved and new features behave per spec; no regressions detected.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing console deprecation warnings about shadow* and pointerEvents from RN-Web internals — unchanged from iteration_3, safe to ignore.

verified_fixes.FIX_1_entry_modal_scroll: PASS — entryHistoryWrap height=200, inner ScrollView scrollHeight=448 > clientHeight=188, programmatic scrollTop change confirmed reaches hist-item-8 (last item in view after scroll). All 9 hist-item-N rendered (numbers + X + XX mixed).
verified_fixes.FIX_2_slot_positions_consistent: PASS — In 4-player INDIVIDUAL mode all four slots are 110x100 with perfectly symmetric distances around the central table (top/bottom = 351.5/351.5px, left/right = 144/144px). In PAIRS mode also 110x100 each, symmetric. Flex row layout (top row, middle row [left+table+right], bottom row) renders cleanly.
verified_fixes.FIX_3_final_round_no_freeze: PASS — With 2 players × 2 rounds, after the last entry the entry modal auto-closed and results-modal opened (~300ms delay). Verified results-modal visible AND entry-modal NOT visible simultaneously — no double-modal glitch, no freeze. App fully responsive afterwards.
verified_fixes.ENH_4_round_complete_banner: PASS — Banner 'الجولة 1 مكتملة • انتقل للجولة 2' appeared after both players submitted round 1, auto-dismissed within ~2.5s. Banner did NOT appear when game became fully complete (no spurious 'انتقل للجولة 3' on a 2-round game).
verified_fixes.ENH_5_animations: PASS — slot-0-total numerically updated from 0 → 33 with pulse animation (Animated.spring scale) without freezing the UI; immediately after the pulse the next slot tap (slot-1) opened its entry-modal. Active slots have glow loop (Animated.loop on shadow). Results modal opens with scale-in spring and rows cascade in (result-row-0, result-row-1 staggered with translateY interpolation).

regressions_verified: players-2 / players-4, rounds-6 / rounds-10, custom-rounds-input + apply-rounds work
entry-number-input + entry-add-number, entry-add-x (-25), entry-add-xx (-50), hist-delete-N, entry-close all wired
back-to-setup shows confirm dialog and resets state on accept
AsyncStorage state persists (used localStorage.clear between flows)
critical_code_review_comments: cards.tsx is now ~1200 lines (down from prior 1499). Still recommend extracting <PlayerSlot/>, <EntryModal/>, <ResultsCard/>, <SetupForm/> into separate files for maintainability (>700-line guideline).
bannerRoundRef tracks last-shown banner round to prevent repeats — clean approach. Reset to 0 in startGame, exitToSetup, newGameSameSetup. Verified.
Auto-results useEffect uses 300ms setTimeout with proper cleanup (clearTimeout) — correct for avoiding double-fire.
PlayerSlot pulse animation uses prevTotal ref to detect change; correctly skips on first mount.

useNativeDriver: true used for all transforms/opacity — good; but shadowOpacity/shadowRadius interpolations on glow are NOT supported by native driver on RN-Web (works because it's web). On native iOS/Android these would fall back. Consider testing on device, or animate opacity of a wrapper instead.
Banner renders with pointerEvents='none' so it doesn't block taps — good.
seed_data_creation: None (localStorage cleared on start; back-to-setup resets between flows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs fixed and 2 enhancements verified at 414x900 viewport. Banner test relies on observing minEntries crossing into a new value while !allDone; for 2-round games the banner only fires once (after round 1). For longer games (e.g., 4 rounds), it fires after rounds 1, 2, 3. The auto-results 300ms setTimeout cleanly closes the entry modal first (verified entry-modal is gone before results-modal appears). Pulse + glow + cascade animations do not block interactions — UI remained tappable throughout.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all reported bugs verified fixed.
